verification_report.summary: All supplied proofs pass under the explicitly accepted prerequisites. The audit verifies the affine second-variation identities and their exact kernels, polarization and gauge invariance on smooth dd^c classes, smooth Riemannian metrics on finite-dimensional affine slices, recovery from value and derivative, the normalized-class/Gauduchon-ray bijection for n>=2, and the separate curve case. Every P1 x P1 normalization is correct: V_mu=2ab for every smooth positive probability measure, distinct factor periods despite equal profiles, the stated Hessian metric, intrinsic completeness of that two-dimensional family, and unit speed of the hyperbola. No BMP, full infinite-dimensional distance claim, boundary extension, or novelty claim is used. Twenty sequential checks and six reference/context checks found no critical errors or gaps. Detailed report: results/gauduchon_volume_hessian_01/verification_report.md. The book was not edited.
